parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and top surface, ensuring stability and load-bearing capacity.
parts.Movement_description: The frame itself is stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically hinged or sliding for access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: The door can swing open or slide, depending on the hinge or track mechanism used.
